title: Apps report their problems to the shop, and staff see them in the back office

apps.what: the apps installed in the API: the payment app (`apps/stripe`) and the email app (`apps/smtp`) of the saleor/apps monorepo, with its shared packages

done: We will call it done when the live shop does it: an app can report and dismiss problems through the API as agreed, staff can read an app's problems in the back office where the installed apps are listed, and our payment and email apps report when the provider or the mail server turns them away. The shop is open while you work: orders are being placed, paid, refunded and confirmed by email, staff are using the back office, and all of that has to keep working.
solution_source: core: saleor/saleor 917690526 (#18724). dashboard: saleor/saleor-dashboard fca0cbf41 (#6283). apps: saleor/apps as of f0d36e14 (#2251, with what came before it since the pin: the schema copies of #2241 and two small changes) and 9c3453dd (#2255); the email app's part (smtp.patch) is ours, upstream has none.
